**Triage Summary:**

The findings cluster into three actionable groups: (1) **OpenSSL 1.1.1l** has 6 HIGH vulnerabilities with available fixes (CVE-2022-0778, CVE-2023-0286, CVE-2022-4450, CVE-2023-0215, CVE-2023-0464) plus 2 CRITICAL CVE-2024-5535 with no fix available; (2) **zlib 1.2.11** has 1 HIGH and 1 CRITICAL (CVE-2022-37434) both with fixes; (3) **busybox 1.34.1** has 1 HIGH with a fix and 1 CRITICAL CVE-2022-48174 with no fix. The unfixed CVEs (CVE-2024-5535 in OpenSSL and CVE-2022-48174 in busybox) are low-EPSS outliers unlikely to be exploited soon, while the fixable vulnerabilities represent genuine upgrade paths.

**Recommended Action:** Upgrade OpenSSL to 1.1.1w+ and zlib to 1.2.13+ immediately to eliminate 7 fixable HIGH/CRITICAL findings. For the two unfixed CVEs, document the risk acceptance or plan a future upgrade when patches become available. Proceed with deployment contingent on these upgrades.
